title: Sound authoring end-to-end — import, frame sync, SWF output
description:
Sound authoring end-to-end is fully implemented. All infrastructure was already in place:

TYPES (packages/core/src/model/types.ts):
- SoundItem, SoundLinkage, SoundEffect, SoundEnvelopePoint types
- Frame.sound field for keyframe sound attachment

SWF ENCODING (packages/swf/src/):
- encodeDefineSound (tag 14) in audio.ts
- encodeStartSound / encodeSoundInfo / effectToEnvelope in sounds.ts
- SoundStreamHead / SoundStreamBlock in audio.ts
- compile.ts emits DefineSound for all SoundItems and StartSound per keyframe sound linkage
  for event/start/stop sync modes; stream mode uses SoundStreamHead+SoundStreamBlock

AUTHORING UI (packages/authoring-ui/src/):
- SoundPanel.tsx: Sound selector, Effect, Sync, Repeat controls
- Shell.tsx: handleSoundChange -> setSoundOnFrame, importSoundToLibrary, SoundEnvelopeDialog
- SoundEnvelopeDialog for custom envelope editing

VERIFICATION:
- Unit tests: sound.test.ts, startsound.test.ts, soundinfo.test.ts, spritesound.test.ts all pass
- E2E oracle: sound-roundtrip.spec.ts (task 0772) — 3 tests, all passed:
  pnpm --filter @flash/desktop e2e --grep sound
  3 passed (8.1s)
  basic StartSound: nonWhitePixels=10000 redPixels=10000 panic=false
  envelope StartSound: nonWhitePixels=10000 redPixels=10000 panic=false
  fadeIn effect: nonWhitePixels=10000 redPixels=10000 panic=false
